evidence: prior entries 34, 35, 36 for the same monthly fee

evidence: payout report 1: gross 3183.48, fees 92.92, net 3090.56, invoices INV-0009 and INV-0010

bank line 27 (+2137.65, ref PAYMENT INV0013, NORTHWIND TRADERS, 2026-04-29)
reasoning.rule: Duplicate bank import: record once, link both lines

reasoning.rule: Intercompany funding received is a liability to the affiliate, not revenue

vendor Courier Express default expense account 6000
